key_findings: The anoctamins subdued and white walker (CG15270) are selectively required in Drosophila CIII neurons for cold nociception but not touch, and CIII neurons use excitatory depolarizing Cl− currents to encode cold.
Overexpression of ncc69 (NKCC1 homologue) in CIII neurons caused spontaneous activity, neuronal hyperexcitability and cold hypersensitivity, modeling neuropathic sensitization.
